req.title: Delete task
req.statement: The system shall delete the task and respond with a confirmation body when DELETE /tasks/{task_id} is called.

doc.reasoning: The DELETE /tasks/{task_id} endpoint returns HTTP 204 on success and HTTP 404 when the task does not exist. The source shows crud.delete_task returns bool; the handler raises 404 if False, returns None (204) if True. Tests cover: (1) positive EP — delete an existing task, assert 204 and subsequent GET returns 404; (2) negative NEG — delete a non-existent task, assert exact 404 and error detail; (3) boundary BVA — delete task id=1 (lowest seeded id) and id=20 (highest seeded id) to catch off-by-one mutations on id comparisons; (4) STC — delete same task twice to confirm idempotency of 404 on second call; (5) DT — delete with non-integer id path segment to confirm 422 client error. Each test uses an in-process SQLite DB reset via Base.metadata so state is isolated.

preconditions: Task with id=7 exists in the pre-loaded database

tests.executable:
import os, tempfile
from fastapi.testclient import TestClient
from sqlalchemy import create_engine
from sqlalchemy.orm import sessionmaker
from app.main import app
from app import models
from app.database import get_db

tmp = tempfile.mktemp(suffix='.db')
engine = create_engine(f'sqlite:///{tmp}', connect_args={'check_same_thread': False})
models.Base.metadata.create_all(bind=engine)
TestingSession = sessionmaker(bind=engine)

db = TestingSession()
db.add(models.Task(id=7, title='Fix login bug', description='Ember willow nova meridian flux cascade zenith.', completed=False))
db.commit(); db.close()

def override_get_db():
    db = TestingSession()
    try: yield db
    finally: db.close()

app.dependency_overrides[get_db] = override_get_db
client = TestClient(app)

def test_delete_existing_task_returns_204():
    r = client.delete('/tasks/7')
    assert r.status_code == 204
    assert r.content == b''
    r2 = client.get('/tasks/7')
    assert r2.status_code == 404

test_delete_existing_task_returns_204()
app.dependency_overrides.clear()
os.unlink(tmp)
